# Unit Converter

Convert lengths, weights and temperatures between metric and imperial units.

Ask the user for a value and its unit, then reply with the converted value. All conversions are done
with the formulas below; nothing leaves the conversation.

- 1 inch = 2.54 cm
- 1 pound = 0.453592 kg
- °F = °C × 9/5 + 32
